settings.question: When will my coffee ship?
settings.answer: We roast on Mondays and ship on Tuesdays. Order by Sunday 6 pm and your beans leave the roastery the day after roasting.

settings.question: How much is shipping?
settings.answer: Free over $45 within the country. Below that it is a flat $5.50, tracked, and usually arrives in two to three days.

settings.question: Do you ship abroad?
settings.answer: Yes, to most of Europe and North America. Rates and duties show at checkout before you pay.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel an order?
settings.answer: Until Sunday 6 pm, yes: reply to your confirmation email or write to the bar. After that it is already in the roaster.

settings.question: How do I pause or skip a delivery?
settings.answer: From your account, under Subscription: skip the next bag, pause for up to three months, or change the cadence at any time.

settings.question: Can I switch coffees between deliveries?
settings.answer: Yes. Pick a new roast before the Sunday cut-off and the next bag follows it. The 15% club price stays.

settings.question: Is there a minimum commitment?
settings.answer: No. Cancel whenever you like; we only ask for a one-line reason so we can get better.

settings.question: Whole bean or ground?
settings.answer: Whole bean keeps its aroma longest. If you have no grinder, pick your brewer at checkout and we grind it on the day it ships.

settings.question: How long do the beans stay fresh?
settings.answer: Best between 7 and 40 days after the roast date printed on the bag. Keep them sealed, cool and out of the light.

settings.question: What ratio should I start with?
settings.answer: 1:16 for filter (15 g to 240 g of water at 94 °C) and 1:2 for espresso. Each bag carries its own recipe card.

settings.question: Do you supply cafés and offices?
settings.answer: Yes, from 5 kg a week. We include barista training, a brew audit and the same Monday roast.

settings.question: Can I visit the roastery first?
settings.answer: Of course. Book a cupping on a Saturday morning at Pier 7 and taste the current lots with our head roaster.
